svg.title: Flash-drum trial at 200 kPa: K at the converged T = 62.8 °C
svg.text: Flash-drum trial at 200 kPa: K at the converged T = 62.8 °C
High-temperature DePriester chart (nomograph), redrawn from Wankat Eq. 2-30 / Table 2-3
Mark p = 200 kPa on the pressure scale (left).
Mark a trial T on the right scale (converged: 62.8 °C; dashed: 50 and 65 °C).
Join the two marks with a straight edge.
Read K: propane 8.51, n-butane 3.32, n-hexane 0.473 (Rachford–Rice f = 0).
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
